data: You fake a creature out with a playful attack that quickly becomes too rough. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target adds -1 to any attack it makes for the remainder of combat. This effect can be stacked to a maximum of -5 to hit.
Brings down the energy of any Pokémon that have already used a move this turn.
Lowers the crowd meter by the number of Pokemon that raised the crowd meter this turn.
